name: Runemaster audit #2738: Focusing Crystals raises magic damage and combat mana regen
contract: Focusing Crystals rank1 705564 / rank2 707879: 'Increases your Magic Damage dealt by $s1% and allows $s3% of
your mana regeneration to continue while in combat.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: Effect0 is
arcane, no physical), EffectBasePoints0 2/5 with DieSides 1 = +3%/+6%. Effect1 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY (a spare
slot, not referenced by this tooltip's $s1/$s3). Effect2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_MANA_REGEN_INTERRUPT (134),
EffectBasePoints2 29/59 with DieSides 1 = 30%/60%. Both are native, generic engine paths -
MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE is read inside Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone via
MOD_MANA_REGEN_INTERRUPT is read directly at StatSystem.cpp:1112
src/server/coa/. The probe spell is Frostbolt 116 (SchoolMask 16 = frost, included in MiscValue 126), used
only to read the generic school-percent-done bonus via SpellDamageBonusDone - it needs no talent
relationship to Runemaster, matching the house convention in bloodmage-atheranns-wickedness.json and
felsworn-wrath-of-sargeras.json. A combat regen simulation is out of reach offline (no runtime sample), so
the mana-regen-interrupt half is instead proven by asserting the aura's own stored effect amount, which is
the exact value StatSystem.cpp reads. Expected: rank1 raises Frostbolt's damage-done bonus by ~3% and stores
a 30 mana-regen-interrupt amount; rank2 raises it by ~6% and stores 60.
